headline: Profit swing masks softer sequential trends and one-offs
summary_short: Revenue rose 10.8% y/y to $3,298M in Q1 FY2026 but eased 6.0% q/q; GXO swung to net income of $4M from a $96M loss a year earlier, helped by a $28M real-estate gain and the absence of last year's $66M regulatory charge, while EBITDA slipped q/q to $175M.
summary_long: Revenue grew 11% y/y (+$321M) on business growth plus $198M of FX tailwind, though it eased q/q in a seasonally softer quarter. Operating income swung to $39M from a $56M loss, mainly on the absence of last year's $66M regulatory VAT charge and lower restructuring costs, partly offset by a new $21M Wincanton divestiture write-down. Direct operating expense fell to 85.1% of revenue from 85.9%, aided by a $28M one-time real-estate benefit. Net income reached $4M versus a $96M loss a year ago. Operating cash flow rose $2M to $31M; cash fell to $794M q/q after $65M of capex; equity was roughly flat at $2,968M. No shares were repurchased; no forward guidance was included in this 10-Q.
